source.source_locator: 教則 第5章 5.2.2(3)「手動操縦におけるヒューマンエラーの傾向」（教則表示ページ60 / PDF viewer 66）

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 手動操縦の方向認知・距離認知リスクには、全方向制御や指定距離着陸の訓練が有効。
evidence.tested_misconception: 機体の向きが変わる状況を避ければ手動操縦技能として十分。
evidence.reasoning_path: manual visual orientation/distance limits -> targeted training -> error mitigation

collision.note: LOW。Q086はmanualの細かな操作適性、Q018-Q021はauto/manual切替。本問は手動操縦固有のhuman-error training。

independent_review.rationale: 5.2.2 identifies manual-control orientation/distance-perception errors and recommends all-direction control and specified-distance landing practice. Existing manual-control coverage tests use-case suitability or takeover, not this targeted training mitigation.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent with the current MLIT 第5版 Chapter 5, preserves second-class scope, and correctly isolates one semantic duplicate. The other 19 candidates test distinct operational process, insurance/security, GNSS-off control, aircraft-specific takeoff/landing technique, human-error mitigation, CRM-skill, and assistant-role propositions with useful practice value. Near-neighbor candidates C004, C012, C014 and C020 remain distinct from the cited canonical questions because they require different causal or operational decision boundaries.
